Key.English: Draw a line from the incoming missile to the unit it is tracking, so it is clear which unit is under threat. Missiles only — a thrown grenade is aimed at a position rather than at a unit.

Report guided missiles fired at a unit to the curators who own that unit. Only guided weapons are reported — ATGMs and lock-on anti-air and anti-tank missiles — so unguided rockets an AI happens to be aiming at the unit are ignored.

Report grenades thrown on a curator's order — Zeus Enhanced's "Throw Grenade" action — to the curators who own units near where it lands. Only curator-ordered throws are reported, so the grenades AI throw of their own accord in a firefight are ignored, as are smoke, chemlights and other harmless throwables. You are warned about a throw your own units are near even if you ordered it yourself.
How close one of your units must be to where an ordered grenade is going to land before you are warned about it, in metres.
Draw a marker on incoming missiles, and on where an ordered grenade is about to land, both in the Zeus camera view and on the Zeus map.
Maximum distance from the camera at which 3D incoming threat markers are drawn.
